name: @prismatic-io/example-project-structure
description: Recommended structure for a Prismatic repo. Includes custom components and code-native integrations.

scripts.build:components: for d in components/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.publish:components: for d in components/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run publish) || exit 1; done
scripts.generate:manifests: for d in components/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run generate:manifest:dev) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:slack: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=slack
scripts.build:teams: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=ms-teams
scripts.build:all: npm run build:components && npm run build:slack && npm run build:teams
scripts.deploy:all: npm run publish:components && npm run import:slack && npm run import:teams
